summary: Former British Columbia lookout in Alberni-Clayoquot; a list of abandoned lookouts says its tower was destroyed or removed.

facts.status_note: Listed as destroyed or removed; no source describes what remains at the site.

evidence.supports: Alberni is listed under the Alberni-Clayoquot area of British Columbia
Page places the site at latitude 49.283, longitude 124.75
Alberni is among the sites that used to have towers and have been destroyed or removed
evidence.quote: The following used to have towers but they have been destroyed/removed :

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Canada Lookouts page gives an elevation of 428 with no unit; the record reads it as metres, but no source confirms that, so the story omits elevation. The record's kind 'unknown' stays open: the sources say only that the site used to have a tower, not what kind of structure it was. A Facebook group post in the BC Forest Fire Lookouts group suggests the lookout was removed before 1980. The page could not be read beyond its title, so it is not cited or used. No BC Forest Service, heritage or news source describing the lookout was found in two searches. Status set to removed from the list in cite 2; access and visit unknown.
